subject: Mutual action plan & launch cadence — LumenHealth post-signature rollout
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Raj <samir@lumenhealth.com>, Priya Kapoor <priya.k@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Chen <procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual action plan & launch cadence — LumenHealth post-signature rollout

Hi Samir / Priya —

Congrats again on completing signature — we’re excited to get started. Attached is the first draft of the MAP (Lumen_MAP_v1.2.xlsx). I embedded the high-level post-signature execution approach so it’s visible to your cross-functional teams. Key goals for this thread:

- Lock go-live window and canary dates by EOD Tuesday (10/06)
- Confirm training targets and trainer roster
- Finalize the minimum scope for the first canary (API-only vs full UI flows)

Quick notes on the attached MAP: the left-hand column is a calendar of milestones; the center shows owners (Redwood vs Lumen); the right-hand column has acceptance criteria and rollback gates. Proposed canary: North region, 50 concurrent sessions, 72-hour observation window.

Can you confirm who from Lumen will own the acceptance sign-off? If you want, we can schedule a 30-min call tomorrow to walk the MAP with your ops and security leads.

Attachments: Lumen_MAP_v1.2.xlsx, Canary_Runbook.pdf (runbook excerpt), trainer_roster.csv (proposal)

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

From: Samir Raj <samir@lumenhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.k@lumenhealth.com>, Alyssa Chen <procurement@lumenhealth.com>, Legal Ops <legal@lumenhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & launch cadence — LumenHealth post-signature rollout

Thanks Soojin — this looks good on first pass. A few clarifications from my side:

1) Acceptance owner: Priya will be the internal product owner for acceptance. She also asked that the initial canary be API-only (no embedded UI) for the first 72 hours to reduce blast radius.

2) Dates: 10/20–10/22 works for the 72-hour canary observation window if we start on the 20th at 00:00 PT.

3) Security/Legal: Legal Ops flagged a short data retention question (we currently need 14-day logs for the audit team). Can you confirm Redwood’s retention policy for canary telemetry and whether we can provide an isolated export?

We’re OK for a quick sync tomorrow at 10am PT.

—Samir
Samir Raj
Head of Platform Integrations, LumenHealth
samir@lumenhealth.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Raj <samir@lumenhealth.com>, Priya Kapoor <priya.k@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Legal Ops <legal@lumenhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & launch cadence — LumenHealth post-signature rollout

Samir — great, thanks. Short answers inline: 

- Canary scope: API-only for the initial 72-hour window is fine; we’ll gate UI traffic until acceptance.
- Dates: we’ll provision target capacity to match the 10/20 start and will send an infrastructure readiness checklist by 10/13.
- Retention: Redwood stores canary telemetry for 30 days by default; for the canary we can generate a scoped export and maintain a separate 14-day slice for your audit team. I’ve looped Karthik to confirm the export process and any KMS requirements.

I’ll also attach an excerpt of the runbook with the rollback checklist and primary telemetry dashboards. If Legal wants further written confirmation on retention we can provide a short addendum.

I’ll take the 10am PT sync — invite incoming.

Cheers,
Soojin

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Samir Raj <samir@lumenhealth.com>, Priya Kapoor <priya.k@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Chen <procurement@lumenhealth.com>, Legal Ops <legal@lumenhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & launch cadence — LumenHealth post-signature rollout

Hey all — follow-up from infra/ops. A few operational items I want to lock into the MAP before we provision: 

- Canary cluster sizing: plan target 2x expected baseline for peak (we’ll provide the sizing calc in the checklist).
- KV/prefix cache: we’ll enable prefix caching for the canary to reduce cold-starts; this requires a short warm-up script (I’ve attached the script stub to the Drive link).
- Rollback triggers: proposed automated triggers: 1) >15% error-rate sustained 15m, 2) 95th percentile latency >2s sustained 10m, 3) anomaly in model quality metrics tied to the eval set. All manual signoffs require Priya + Redwood eng on call.

On the retention/export: we support an S3 export via a customer bucket with KMS. Laura — can you confirm the S3 export steps and a contact at Lumen for key rotation?

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Prod Infra Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Priya Kapoor <priya.k@lumenhealth.com>

Date: 2026-10-08T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & launch cadence — LumenHealth post-signature rollout

Thanks everyone — this aligns with our expectations. Priya confirming acceptance owner as Priya Kapoor. A couple final asks before we lock: 

- Please update the MAP to mark canary as API-only and add the rollback triggers Karthik listed.
- Add an explicit trainer bootcamp week (10/12–10/16) with two half-day sessions for ops and support; roster attached (trainer_roster.csv).
- Legal wants a short note about telemetry retention exported to our S3 (KMS alias: alias/lumen-audit); they will sign the addendum once we get that in writing.

If Redwood can update the MAP by COB Monday (10/11) we’ll sign off on the canary dates and confirm the procurement PO.

I’ll sign the runbook acceptance when we finish the bootcamp.

Best,
Priya Kapoor
Senior Product Manager — Integrations, LumenHealth
priya.k@lumenhealth.com
